FBH-01-002-b.id: Hampir! Pertanyaan itu membuat orang tergoda. Integritas tidak bergantung pada siapa yang melihat. {model}
FBH-01-002-b.en: Almost! That question tempts people. Integrity doesn't depend on who's watching. {model}

FBH-01-002-c.id: Hampir! Uang itu milik penjual, berapa pun jumlahnya. {model}
FBH-01-002-c.en: Almost! The money is the seller's, however much it is. {model}

FBH-01-004-b.id: Hampir! Satu atau banyak, tetap bukan hasil kerjamu. {model}
FBH-01-004-b.en: Almost! One or many, it still isn't your own work. {model}

FBH-01-004-c.id: Hampir! Itu juga menyontek, dan mengganggu temanmu. {model}
FBH-01-004-c.en: Almost! That's copying too, and it disturbs your friend. {model}

FBH-01-007-b.id: Hampir! Badan besar tidak membuat haknya lebih besar. {model}
FBH-01-007-b.en: Almost! Being bigger doesn't give anyone a bigger share. {model}

FBH-01-007-c.id: Hampir! Yang cepat belum tentu adil. Bagian yang sama lebih adil di sini. {model}
FBH-01-007-c.en: Almost! Being fast isn't the same as fair. Equal pieces are fairer here. {model}

FBH-01-008-left_out.id: Hampir! Kalau dibiarkan, ia tidak pernah ikut bermain. Itu tidak adil. {model}
FBH-01-008-left_out.en: Almost! If we leave it, they never get to play. That isn't fair. {model}

FBH-01-008-cut_queue.id: Hampir! Menyerobot giliran membuat ia makin lama menunggu. {model}
FBH-01-008-cut_queue.en: Almost! Jumping the turn makes them wait even longer. {model}

FBH-01-011-b.id: Hampir! Adil artinya setiap orang bisa belajar. Ia butuh tempat itu untuk melihat papan. {model}
FBH-01-011-b.en: Almost! Fair means everyone can learn. They need that seat to see the board. {model}

FBH-01-011-c.id: Hampir! Kebutuhan melihat papan tidak bergantung pada nilai. {model}
FBH-01-011-c.en: Almost! Needing to see the board has nothing to do with marks. {model}

FBH-01-013-b.id: Hampir! Tidak dilihat bukan berarti boleh. Pemiliknya mungkin sedang mencari. {model}
FBH-01-013-b.en: Almost! Not being seen doesn't make it okay. The owner may be looking for it. {model}

FBH-01-013-c.id: Hampir! Uang itu tetap milik orang lain. {model}
FBH-01-013-c.en: Almost! The money still belongs to someone else. {model}

FBH-01-014-count_marble_3.id: Hampir! Kalau tiap anak dapat 3, butuh 9 kelereng. Kita hanya punya 6. {model}
FBH-01-014-count_marble_3.en: Almost! If each got 3, we'd need 9 marbles. We only have 6. {model}

FBH-01-014-count_marble_1.id: Hampir! Kalau tiap anak dapat 1, masih sisa 3. Bagi sampai habis. {model}
FBH-01-014-count_marble_1.en: Almost! If each got 1, there'd be 3 left over. Share them all out. {model}

FBH-02-001-happy.id: Hampir! Lihat lagi: ia duduk sendiri sementara yang lain bermain. {model}
FBH-02-001-happy.en: Almost! Look again: they sit alone while the others play. {model}

FBH-02-001-cold.id: Hampir! Dingin itu rasa di kulit. Coba tebak perasaan di hatinya. {model}
FBH-02-001-cold.en: Almost! Cold is something your skin feels. Guess what their heart feels. {model}

FBH-02-003-b.id: Hampir! Ia mungkin kesepian di rumah. Sedikit perhatian sangat berarti. {model}
FBH-02-003-b.en: Almost! They may feel lonely at home. A little care means a lot. {model}

FBH-02-003-c.id: Hampir! Itu bisa jadi kabar yang belum tentu benar dan membuatnya malu. {model}
FBH-02-003-c.en: Almost! That might not even be true, and it could embarrass them. {model}

FBH-02-005-run.id: Hampir! Kalau ditinggal lari, ia bisa bingung dan tersesat. {model}
FBH-02-005-run.en: Almost! If you run off, they could get confused and lost. {model}

FBH-02-005-read.id: Hampir! Membaca bisa nanti. Ia butuh ditunjukkan jalan sekarang. {model}
FBH-02-005-read.en: Almost! Reading can wait. They need someone to show the way now. {model}

FBH-02-009-b.id: Hampir! Itu bisa merusak dan menyakiti. Di cerita, ia memilih menenangkan diri. {model}
FBH-02-009-b.en: Almost! That could break things and hurt someone. In the story, they chose to calm down. {model}

FBH-02-009-c.id: Hampir! Menyalahkan membuat suasana makin panas. {model}
FBH-02-009-c.en: Almost! Blaming makes things even more heated. {model}

FBH-02-013-b.id: Hampir! Kalimat itu membuatnya makin sedih. Perasaannya penting. {model}
FBH-02-013-b.en: Almost! That makes them feel worse. Their feelings matter. {model}

FBH-02-013-c.id: Hampir! Nanti boleh. Sekarang ia butuh ditemani dulu. {model}
FBH-02-013-c.en: Almost! Later is fine. Right now they need company. {model}

FBH-02-014-b.id: Hampir! Membalas membuat dua orang sedih. Tenangkan diri dulu. {model}
FBH-02-014-b.en: Almost! Getting even makes two people sad. Calm down first. {model}

FBH-02-014-c.id: Hampir! Kesal yang disimpan terus bisa membuatmu tidak nyaman. Lebih baik dibicarakan. {model}
FBH-02-014-c.en: Almost! Bottled-up anger can make you feel bad. It's better to talk about it. {model}

body.id: Integritas artinya tetap berbuat benar, walaupun tidak ada yang melihat.
body.en: Integrity means doing the right thing, even when no one is watching.

body.id: Adil artinya setiap orang mendapat kesempatan yang layak, dan aturan berlaku untuk semua.
body.en: Fairness means everyone gets a proper chance, and the rules apply to all.

body.id: Kalau ragu, tanyakan: "Apakah aku tetap melakukannya kalau semua orang tahu?"
body.en: When unsure, ask: "Would I still do it if everyone knew?"

body.id: Empati artinya mencoba merasakan apa yang dirasakan orang lain.
body.en: Empathy means trying to feel what someone else feels.

body.id: Marah itu wajar. Yang penting, apa yang kita lakukan saat marah.
body.en: Feeling angry is normal. What matters is what we do with it.

body.id: Coba: berhenti, tarik napas pelan, lalu bicarakan baik-baik.
body.en: Try this: stop, breathe slowly, then talk it through calmly.

ST-NIL-K-H-INTEGRITAS.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Sore itu, seorang anak disuruh membeli gula di warung. Antreannya panjang.
caption.en: That afternoon, a child is sent to buy sugar at the warung. The queue is long.

caption.id: Penjual sibuk dan memberi kembalian terlalu banyak. Tidak ada yang melihat.
caption.en: The busy seller gives back too much change. No one notices.

caption.id: Anak itu berhenti sejenak dan bertanya dalam hati, "Kalau semua orang tahu, apakah aku tetap menyimpannya?"
caption.en: The child pauses and wonders, "If everyone knew, would I still keep it?"

caption.id: Ia mengembalikan uang itu. Penjual berterima kasih, karena uang itu hasil kerjanya hari itu.
caption.en: They hand the money back. The seller says thank you: that money came from a hard day's work.

caption.id: Sejak itu, penjual selalu menyapanya dengan ramah. Kejujuran membangun kepercayaan.
caption.en: Since then, the seller always greets them warmly. Honesty builds trust.

ST-NIL-K-H-SABAR.figure: Aya dan teman-teman (tokoh rekaan / fictional characters)
ST-NIL-K-H-SABAR.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Anak-anak membangun menara dari kardus untuk tugas kelompok.
caption.en: The children are building a cardboard tower for a group project.

caption.id: Menara tersenggol dan roboh. Seorang anak marah sekali dan ingin berteriak.
caption.en: The tower gets bumped and falls. One child is really angry and wants to shout.

caption.id: Ia berhenti, menarik napas pelan, dan menghitung sampai lima.
caption.en: They stop, breathe slowly and count to five.

caption.id: Teman yang menyenggol meminta maaf. "Tidak apa-apa, ayo kita bangun lagi," jawabnya.
caption.en: The friend who bumped it says sorry. "It's okay, let's build it again," comes the reply.

caption.id: Menara kedua malah lebih kokoh. Tenang membantu kita berpikir jernih.
caption.en: The second tower is even sturdier. Staying calm helps us think clearly.

model_answer.id: Integritas: berbuat benar walau tidak ada yang melihat.
model_answer.en: Integrity: doing right even when no one watches.

meaning.id: Pertanyaan apa yang membantu anak itu memilih?
meaning.en: Which question helped the child decide?

text.id: "Kalau semua tahu, apakah aku tetap melakukannya?"
text.en: "If everyone knew, would I still do it?"

model_answer.id: "Kalau semua orang tahu, apakah aku tetap melakukannya?" Pertanyaan ini membantu kita memilih yang benar.
model_answer.en: "If everyone knew, would I still do it?" This question helps us choose what's right.

meaning.id: Di cerita, anak itu jujur karena takut dimarahi.
meaning.en: In the story, the child was honest out of fear of a telling-off.

model_answer.id: Tidak ada yang melihat, jadi tidak ada yang akan memarahinya. Ia jujur karena ingin berbuat benar.
model_answer.en: No one saw, so no one would have scolded them. They were honest because they wanted to do right.

meaning.id: Guru keluar sebentar saat ulangan. Jawaban teman terlihat.
meaning.en: The teacher steps out during a test. A friend's answers are in view.

text.en: Ask the friend next to me

model_answer.id: Tetap kerjakan sendiri. Nilaimu menunjukkan apa yang benar-benar kamu pahami, dan itu membantumu belajar.
model_answer.en: Keep doing your own work. Your mark shows what you really understand, and that helps you learn.

meaning.id: Tetap benar walau tak dilihat?
meaning.en: Still right when no one's watching?

text.id: Menyalin PR teman dan mengaku buatan sendiri
text.en: Copying homework and calling it your own

text.id: Mengaku memecahkan pot walau tak ada yang tahu
text.en: Owning up to a broken pot no one saw

model_answer.id: Berintegritas: mengembalikan kembalian, mengaku jujur, mengembalikan barang temuan. Menyalin PR dan membuang sampah saat sepi kurang baik: benar atau salah tidak berubah walau tidak ada yang melihat.
model_answer.en: Integrity: handing back change, owning up, returning what you find. Copying homework and littering when no one's around are not so good: right and wrong don't change when nobody is looking.

meaning.id: Pasangkan dengan pilihan yang lebih baik.
meaning.en: Match each with a better choice.

model_answer.id: Buang sampah di tempatnya, antre, belajar sendiri, dan kirim pesan yang baik, juga saat tidak ada yang melihat.
model_answer.en: Use the bin, queue, study for yourself and send kind messages, even when no one is watching.

meaning.id: Ada 1 kue untuk 4 anak.
meaning.en: There's 1 cake for 4 children.

text.id: Yang badannya paling besar dapat paling banyak
text.en: The biggest child gets the most

text.id: Yang paling cepat boleh memilih dulu

model_answer.id: Potong menjadi 4 bagian yang sama, supaya semua mendapat bagian yang sama besar.
model_answer.en: Cut it into 4 equal pieces, so everyone gets the same.

meaning.id: Dalam permainan, satu teman belum pernah dapat giliran.
meaning.en: In a game, one friend hasn't had a turn yet.

model_answer.id: Beri ia giliran. Adil artinya semua pemain mendapat kesempatan.
model_answer.en: Give them a turn. Fair means every player gets a chance.

meaning.id: Adil atau tidak adil?
meaning.en: Fair or unfair?

text.en: The one who pushes in is served first
The cake is cut into equal pieces

text.id: Hanya teman dekat yang boleh ikut main
Aturan rumah sama untuk kakak dan adik
text.en: House rules are the same for older and younger

model_answer.id: Adil: giliran untuk semua, kue sama besar, aturan sama untuk semua. Tidak adil: menyerobot dan hanya mengajak teman dekat.
model_answer.en: Fair: turns for everyone, equal cake, the same rules for all. Unfair: pushing in and only letting close friends play.

meaning.id: Cara adil membagi kue berdua: satu memotong, yang lain memilih lebih dulu.
meaning.en: A fair way for two to share a cake: one cuts, the other chooses first.

model_answer.id: Cara "aku potong, kamu pilih" membuat pemotong berusaha adil, karena ia mendapat potongan terakhir.
model_answer.en: "I cut, you choose" makes the cutter try to be fair, because they get the last piece.

meaning.id: Teman berkacamata duduk di depan supaya bisa melihat papan.
meaning.en: A friend with glasses sits at the front to see the board.

text.id: Tidak adil, semua harus duduk sama
text.en: Unfair, everyone must sit the same

text.id: Adil, karena ia butuh itu untuk belajar
text.en: Fair, because they need it to learn

text.id: Adil hanya kalau ia juara kelas
text.en: Fair only if they're top of the class

model_answer.id: Adil tidak selalu berarti semua sama. Kadang adil berarti memberi yang dibutuhkan, supaya semua bisa belajar.
model_answer.en: Fair doesn't always mean the same for everyone. Sometimes it means giving what's needed, so everyone can learn.

model_answer.id: Saat bermain di rumah, jadilah "penjaga adil": pastikan semua mendapat giliran dan aturannya sama untuk semua.
model_answer.en: Next time you play at home, be the "fairness keeper": make sure everyone gets a turn and the rules are the same for all.

meaning.id: Kamu menemukan uang di kolong meja kelas.
meaning.en: You find money under a desk at school.

text.id: Simpan, karena tidak ada yang melihat
text.en: Keep it, since no one saw

model_answer.id: Serahkan kepada guru, supaya bisa dikembalikan kepada pemiliknya.
model_answer.en: Hand it to the teacher, so it can go back to its owner.

meaning.id: Ada 6 kelereng untuk 3 anak. Berapa untuk tiap anak?
meaning.en: There are 6 marbles for 3 children. How many each?

model_answer.id: 2 kelereng untuk tiap anak: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6. Semua mendapat sama banyak.
model_answer.en: 2 marbles each: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6. Everyone gets the same.

items.source: Brosnan, S. F., & de Waal, F. B. M. (2003). Monkeys reject unequal pay. Nature, 425(6955), 297–299. doi:10.1038/nature01963

model_answer.id: Dalam sebuah percobaan, monyet kapusin menukar batu kecil dengan makanan. Kalau temannya mendapat anggur yang manis untuk tugas yang sama, monyet yang hanya mendapat mentimun sering menolak!
model_answer.en: In an experiment, capuchin monkeys swapped small stones for food. When a partner got a sweet grape for the same task, the monkey given only cucumber often refused it!

meaning.id: Anak ini duduk sendirian. Apa perasaannya?
meaning.en: This child is sitting alone. How might they feel?

model_answer.id: Kemungkinan besar ia sedih. Kalau kita bisa merasakannya, kita tahu ia butuh diajak.
model_answer.en: Most likely they feel sad. When we sense that, we know they need an invitation.

meaning.id: Perasaan teman, lalu apa yang membantu?
meaning.en: A friend's feeling, and what helps?

text.en: Offer to help carry their things
Share the joy and say well done

model_answer.id: Sedih: temani. Lelah: bantu. Senang: ikut senang. Lapar: berbagi. Empati menuntun kita pada cara menolong.
model_answer.en: Sad: stay close. Tired: help out. Happy: share the joy. Hungry: share food. Empathy shows us how to help.

meaning.id: Temanmu sakit dan tidak masuk sekolah tiga hari.
meaning.en: Your friend has been off sick for three days.

text.id: Kirim pesan atau menjenguk, lalu berbagi catatan
text.en: Send a message or visit, then share notes

text.id: Bercerita ke semua orang bahwa ia sakit parah

model_answer.id: Kirim pesan atau jenguk bersama orang tua, lalu bagikan catatan pelajaran supaya ia tidak tertinggal.
model_answer.en: Send a message or visit with a parent, then share your notes so they don't fall behind.

meaning.id: Kalau teman sedang sedih, yang terbaik selalu langsung menasihatinya panjang lebar.
meaning.en: When a friend is sad, the best thing is always to give them a long lecture.

model_answer.id: Teman yang sedih biasanya lebih butuh didengarkan dulu. Nasihat bisa nanti, kalau ia mau.
model_answer.en: A sad friend usually needs to be listened to first. Advice can come later, if they want it.

meaning.id: Teman barumu belum tahu letak kantin.
meaning.en: Your new classmate doesn't know where the canteen is.

model_answer.id: Antar ia ke kantin. Ingat rasanya jadi anak baru: semua terasa asing.
model_answer.en: Walk them there. Remember how it feels to be new: everything seems strange.

meaning.id: Saat teman bercerita sedih, aku menatapnya, ____ dengan tenang, lalu bertanya pelan.
meaning.en: When a friend shares something sad, I look at them, ____ quietly, then ask gently.

model_answer.id: Mendengarkan dengan tenang membuat teman merasa dipahami.
model_answer.en: Listening quietly helps a friend feel understood.

model_answer.id: Marah itu wajar. Berhenti dan menarik napas membantu kita memilih cara yang baik.
model_answer.en: Anger is normal. Stopping to breathe helps us choose a good way forward.

meaning.id: Apa yang terjadi di cerita?
meaning.en: What happened in the story?

model_answer.id: Marah dulu, lalu menarik napas, lalu saling memaafkan dan membangun lagi.
model_answer.en: First anger, then slow breaths, then making up and building again.

meaning.id: Apa yang membantu anak itu tidak berteriak?
meaning.en: What helped the child not shout?

model_answer.id: Ia berhenti, menarik napas pelan, dan menghitung sampai lima. Setelah tenang, ia bisa berpikir jernih.
model_answer.en: They stopped, breathed slowly and counted to five. Once calm, they could think clearly.

meaning.id: Saat kamu marah.
meaning.en: When you feel angry.

model_answer.id: Berhenti, tarik napas, sebutkan perasaanmu, lalu cari jalan keluar bersama.
model_answer.en: Stop, breathe, name the feeling, then find a way forward together.

meaning.id: Cara apa yang baik saat marah?
meaning.en: Which ways help when you're angry?

model_answer.id: Membantu: menarik napas, bercerita, menjauh sebentar. Membanting barang dan pesan kasar bisa menyakiti orang lain atau diri sendiri.
model_answer.en: Helpful: breathing, talking it over, stepping away. Throwing things and rude messages can hurt others or ourselves.

meaning.id: Merasa marah itu wajar. Yang penting kita tidak menyakiti siapa pun.
meaning.en: Feeling angry is normal. What matters is not hurting anyone.

model_answer.id: Semua orang pernah marah. Kita bisa memilih cara yang tidak menyakiti.
model_answer.en: Everyone gets angry sometimes. We can choose a way that doesn't hurt.

meaning.id: Temanmu kalah lomba dan menangis.
meaning.en: Your friend lost a race and is crying.

text.en: Start talking about the next race

text.id: Duduk di dekatnya: "Kamu sudah berusaha keras."
text.en: Sit with them: "You tried really hard."

model_answer.id: Temani dan akui usahanya. Saat sedih, orang butuh merasa dimengerti.
model_answer.en: Stay with them and notice their effort. When we're sad, we need to feel understood.

meaning.id: Adikmu merusak gambarmu. Kamu kesal sekali.
meaning.en: Your little sibling ruins your drawing. You're really upset.

text.en: Say nothing and stay upset for days

text.id: Tarik napas, lalu bilang, "Aku sedih gambarku rusak."
text.en: Breathe, then say, "I'm sad my drawing is ruined."

model_answer.id: Tenangkan diri, lalu katakan perasaanmu dengan jelas. Adikmu jadi tahu akibat perbuatannya.
model_answer.en: Calm down, then say clearly how you feel. Your sibling learns what their action did.

meaning.id: Aku tak terlihat, tapi bisa kamu pegang. Kalau kamu menepatiku, orang jadi percaya padamu. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: You can't see me, but you can keep me. When you do, people trust you. What am I?

model_answer.id: Janji! Janji bisa "dipegang" dan ditepati.
model_answer.en: A promise! You keep it, and people trust you.
